topic:ucat-2026:structure:2027.verified_value: Four separately timed multiple-choice subtests: Verbal Reasoning, Decision Making, Quantitative Reasoning and Situational Judgement. The three cognitive subtests give a total score of 900–2700; Situational Judgement is reported as a band
topic:ucat-2026:structure:2027.quote: The test consists of four separately timed subtests in multiple-choice format: Verbal Reasoning … Decision Making … Quantitative Reasoning … Situational Judgement … You will receive a total score of 900-2700 and a Situational Judgement Band. [Abstract Reasoning is not mentioned; the earlier wording about its removal is not on the page]

topic:ucat-2026:subtests:2027.verified_value: Verbal Reasoning 44 questions / 22 minutes; Decision Making 35 / 37; Quantitative Reasoning 36 / 26; Situational Judgement 69 / 26. Each cognitive subtest scaled 300–900; Situational Judgement reported in Bands 1–4. The standard test is just under 2 hours
topic:ucat-2026:subtests:2027.quote: Verbal Reasoning 44 1 minute 30 seconds 22 minutes 300 - 900 Decision Making 35 1 minute 30 seconds 37 minutes 300 - 900 Quantitative Reasoning 36 2 minutes 26 minutes 300 - 900 Situational Judgement 69 1 minute 30 seconds 26 minutes Bands 1 - 4 … The standard test is just under 2 hours.

topic:gmc-registration:mla:2027.verified_value: All medical students graduating from UK universities need to pass the Medical Licensing Assessment (MLA) as part of their degree before joining the medical register. The MLA has an applied knowledge test (AKT) and a clinical and professional skills assessment (CPSA)
topic:gmc-registration:mla:2027.quote: All medical students graduating from UK universities need to pass the MLA as part of their degree before joining the medical register. … Clinical and professional skills assessment (CPSA) Applied knowledge test (AKT) [the 2024/25 start year is not stated on this page]

topic:gmc-registration:provisional_regis.verified_value: Provisional registration with a licence to practise allows doctors to take part in an approved Foundation Year 1 (F1) programme in the UK
topic:gmc-registration:provisional_regis.quote: Provisional registration with a licence to practise allows doctors to take part in an approved Foundation Year 1 (F1) Programme in the UK.
